lines.en: The Little Red Hen
This is a story about a little red hen.
lines.zh: 这是一个关于小红母鸡的故事。

lines.en: The little red hen lives on a farm.
lines.zh: 小红母鸡住在一个农场上。

lines.en: She works hard all day long: She pecks the ground.
lines.zh: 她整天辛勤地干活：她用嘴啄地。

lines.en: She looks for worms.
She sits in a bush.
And sometimes… she lays an egg.
The little red hen has three friends: A cat A dog And a horse.
lines.zh: 小红母鸡有三个朋友：一只猫、一只狗和一匹马。

lines.en: These animals don’t work hard at all.
lines.zh: 这几位可一点也不干活。

lines.en: The cat likes to sleep in the sun.
The dog likes to sleep in the shade.
And the horse likes to watch TV all day long.
One day the little red hen sees a raspberry bush.
lines.zh: 一天，小红母鸡看见一丛树莓。

lines.en: Raspberries!
” she squeals.
“Yum yum yum!
We can make a raspberry cake!
lines.zh: 我们可以做一个树莓蛋糕！

lines.en: ” The little red hen runs to tell her friends.
lines.zh: ”小红母鸡跑去告诉她的朋友们。

lines.en: “Guys!
There are raspberries over there!
We can make a raspberry cake!
lines.zh: 我们可以做一个树莓蛋糕！

lines.en: ” The dog drools.
"Yes!"
The cat licks her lips.
"Absolutely!"
The horse flicks his tail.
"What a great idea!"
So… who wants to help me pick the raspberries?
lines.zh: 那么……谁愿意帮我摘树莓呢？

lines.en: ” asks the little red hen.
“Not me,” says the dog, “I’m too busy.
” “Not me,” says the cat, “I’m too tired.
” “Not me,” says the horse, “I’m watching TV.
lines.zh: ”“我可不行，”马说，“我在看电视呢。

lines.en: "Then I will do it myself,” says the little red hen.
lines.zh: “那我就自己来吧，”小红母鸡说。

lines.en: So she picks the berries, one by one, all by herself.
lines.zh: 于是她一颗一颗地把树莓摘下来，全靠她自己。

lines.en: "Ok, now we need flour, and sugar, and milk, and butter," says the little red hen.
lines.zh: “好了，现在我们需要面粉、糖、牛奶和黄油，”小红母鸡说。

lines.en: “Who wants to help me get them?
” “Not me,” says the dog, “I’m too busy.
” “Not me,” says the cat, “I’m too tired.
” “Not me,” says the horse, “I’m watching TV.
lines.zh: ”“我可不行，”马说，“我在看电视呢。

lines.en: “Then I will do it myself,” says the little red hen.
lines.zh: “那我就自己来吧，”小红母鸡说。

lines.en: She goes all the way to the pantry and gets the flour and the sugar.
lines.zh: 她一路走到储藏室，取来面粉和糖。

lines.en: She goes all the way to the fridge and gets the butter and the milk.
lines.zh: 她又一路走到冰箱前，取来黄油和牛奶。

lines.en: Then she puts everything together into a big bowl, all by herself.
lines.zh: 然后她把所有东西放进一个大碗里，全靠她自己。

lines.en: “Who wants to help me mix the cake batter?
” asks the little red hen.
“Not me,” says the dog, “I’m too busy.
” “Not me,” says the cat, “I’m too tired.
” “Not me,” says the horse, “I’m watching TV.
lines.zh: ”“我可不行，”马说，“我在看电视呢。

lines.en: ” “Then I will do it myself!
” says the little red hen.
She mixes the batter until it is smooth and creamy.
lines.zh: 她把面糊搅拌得又滑又细腻。

lines.en: Then she gently stirs through the raspberries.
lines.zh: 然后她轻轻地把树莓拌进去。

lines.en: She pours the batter into a cake tin.
lines.zh: 她把面糊倒进蛋糕模子里。

lines.en: Then she puts it in the oven.
All by herself.
(Tick tock, tick tock) Soon there is a delicious smell coming from the kitchen.
lines.zh: （滴答，滴答）没过多久，厨房里飘出了香喷喷的味道。

lines.en: The dog can smell it.
The cat can smell it.
The horse can smell it too.
They all rush to the kitchen.
The little red hen takes the cake from the oven.
lines.zh: 小红母鸡把蛋糕从烤箱里端出来。

lines.en: She puts it on a plate and sprinkles it with sugar.
lines.zh: 她把蛋糕放在盘子里，撒上一层糖。

lines.en: “So… Who wants to help me eat this cake?
lines.zh: “那么……谁愿意帮我一起吃这个蛋糕？

lines.en: ” asks the little red hen.
“Me!
” Says the dog.
“Me!
” Says the cat.
“Me!
” Says the horse.
“I don’t think so,” says the little red hen.
“You would not help me make this cake… so you will not help me eat it.
lines.zh: “你们不肯帮我做这个蛋糕……所以也别想帮我吃它。

lines.en: ” She runs away with the cake and eats every last crumb.
lines.zh: ”她端着蛋糕跑开了，连最后一点碎屑都吃得干干净净。

lines.en: All by herself.
